plugins.cameraPermission: Village uses your camera to scan baby food barcodes.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Parent Patch needs background location to detect when you've stopped driving, even if the app isn't open, so it can remind you to check the back seat.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Parent Patch checks your driving speed to remind you to check the back seat when you stop.
